note: The only place a file may be left out of coverage. `path` is a repository-relative path or a glob (* within a folder, ** across folders). Every entry needs a plain-sentence `reason`; scripts/check-coverage-ratchet.mjs fails without one. Generated code is not listed: coverlet already drops it by the compiler's GeneratedCode and CompilerGenerated marks and by the obj folder (tests/coverage.runsettings).

exclusions.reason: Only Windows system calls (processor times, memory, disk counters) and the handle loop around them; every decision about their answers is in WindowsNativeRules.cs, which is tested. The calls cannot run on the Linux coverage runner.
Only Windows WMI and registry questions; every decision about their answers is in WindowsReadingRules.cs, which is tested. The calls cannot run on the Linux coverage runner.
One Windows call that sizes a network share; the volume reading around it is in VolumeSpace.cs, which is tested with the call replaced. The call cannot run on the Linux coverage runner.
Only the two Windows data-protection calls; the protector around them (WindowsDpapiSecretProtector.cs) is tested with the calls replaced. The calls cannot run on the Linux coverage runner.
